name: rule-1
label: Rule 1 · Any protocol
title: Not tied to one communication protocol
summary: In brief: identification is separate from interaction; any URI scheme may identify.
quote: “A REST API should not be dependent on any single communication protocol, though its successful mapping to a given protocol may be dependent on the availability of metadata, choice of methods, etc. In general, any protocol element that uses a URI for identification must allow any URI scheme to be used for the sake of that identification. [Failure here implies that identification is not separated from interaction.]”
cite: Roy T. Fielding, “REST APIs must be hypertext-driven”
